verdict.rationale: Adyen Issuing is an API-driven platform, so scoped API credentials for an agent is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack never mentions API keys, credential roles, permission scopes, or least-privilege credential issuance. Card-level controls such as transaction rules, suspending cards, and relayed authorisation are adjacent spend controls on payment instruments, not scoped API credentials, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
